integrity: Equations and Poincare-Lindstedt solvability are checked symbolically and corroborated by five independent numerical periodic-shooting solutions. These are self-review, not independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a nondegenerate planar Hopf point and applies only to sufficiently small cycles; it excludes the generalized Hopf boundary, large cycles and global monotonicity. Some early full texts were inaccessible and historical priority is not conclusively known.
title: Universal nonlinear period softening at nondegenerate FitzHugh–Nagumo Hopf points
